title: 第二十三章 劫难解机缘至第二十四章 神念穿梭的玄机
lines: 雷涅此时的神情，依然处于呆滞之中，冷汗已经浸透了其背后的衣衫。
先前那种，似要于刹那间，被声势大涨的破空真火给强行吞噬，所袭涌而出的惊悚，依旧在雷涅心中盘旋，久久未能涣散泯灭！
而正是因其处于此种状态，雷涅丝毫没有察觉，盘旋于高空之上的冥陆老怪，身形早已于原地消失不见！
此时，其正携带着，从体内散溢而开的滔天杀意，往雷涅身形所矗之处遁袭而去。
其也是看明白了，这雷涅一时半会，不会从先前，破空真火所带来的震惊中苏醒。
所以此时不出手将之斩灭，更待合时？！
冥陆老怪往雷涅身躯遁飞的越近，其心头这道念头便越发变的强烈！
直到后来，其身形已是闪至雷涅身遭一丈之近！
单手化掌为刀！
其上充斥着极为锋锐的玄气波动！
脸庞流露出狰狞诡笑。
可返观雷涅，依然是呆愣的矗立在原地，丝毫没有察觉，那即将给自身带来致命一击的森然攻势！
而就在……冥陆老怪所施展而出的暗袭之击，将要轰中雷涅心脏部位的要害之点，让其彻底魂归天外时。
雷涅身侧，一道略显模糊的身影，霎时凝现而出。
其甚至连身躯都未彻底凝实，却是直接祭出一掌，将冥陆老怪的骇人攻势给强行束缚住！
使得此道袭击再无法向前潜入半寸。
而此时，冥陆老怪的手掌与雷涅的要害之点，仅仅相隔一指间距！
此间发生之事虽然诉说起来颇显繁琐，但其实这些都是于瞬息间发生而起的！
并且其中凶险程度，也终是达到了，能将雷涅从呆立状态下惊醒的峰值之点！
从呆滞的神情中，转醒而出的雷涅。
脸色顿时涌起惊戒与暴怒，盯向那正眼神森然，目光全部集中在了旁边出手阻拦自己攻势之人的冥陆老怪。
瞧得这冥陆老怪根本没看向自己，雷涅也是略一扭首，朝着冥陆老怪目光所及之处望去。
只见先前还未凝实的身影，已是自其探出的双掌为起点，由外向内，由点展面，于顷刻间全部凝现而出。
身影此刻眼神虽略显凝重，却是掩盖不住其嘴角流溢而出的，嘲弄笑意。
观其面貌，正是在见到冥陆老怪要趁雷涅陷入僵态，欲要将之斩杀，出手阻拦的化圣门灵青圣——“灵老头！”
“老怪！你找死不成？！”
冥陆老怪充满森然杀意的话语，自雷涅与灵青圣两人耳中传荡而开。
“呵呵，冥道友此般行事有点不符合规矩吧？！”
“先前雷道友已是接下你那破空真火的全力攻击，按照此间规矩，雷道友已经算是挑战成功，你也不能再对其动手了！”
灵青圣闻言，却是讥讽一笑，淡然说道。
冥陆老怪冷哼一声，有些不善的盯向灵青圣与雷涅，目光在二者的脸庞上扫视了一圈。
随即开口，低沉说道。
“这雷涅竟能有两件法宝，想来是你借他的吧？！”
“看你灵老怪花费这般大的代价份上，就算此人达成了挑战！其接下来便不必再参加接下来的双国争斗了！”
“不过，姓雷的！弟子血炼中，你可得让你门下弟子好生相互照看着点，别到时候，搞得个全军覆灭的下场！”
在向灵青圣与雷涅，各自撂下讥讽之言与威胁之语后，那冥陆老怪当即袖袍一甩，身影忽的一阵模糊，在雷涅二人眼皮轻眨间，消失不见。
content_en:
Rene's expression at this time was still sluggish, and cold sweat had soaked the clothes on his back.
The horror that surged out from before, as if it was about to be forcibly swallowed up by the sky-breaking true fire in an instant, was still swirling in Reine's heart, and it could not be dissipated for a long time!
And precisely because of this state, Rene did not notice at all that the figure of the old monster from the Underworld hovering high in the sky had long since disappeared!
At this time, it was carrying the monstrous murderous intent that spread out from the body, and fled towards the place where Reine's figure stood.
He also understood that this Rene would not wake up from the shock caused by the Sky-breaking True Fire for a while.
So if you don't kill it now, why don't you wait until the right time? !
The closer the old monster of Minglu flew to Reine's body, the more intense the thought in his mind became!
It wasn't until later that his figure had already flashed up to Rene and was within ten feet of him!
Turn your palm into a knife with one hand!
It is filled with extremely sharp profound energy fluctuations!
A ferocious smile appeared on his face.
But when he looked back, Rene was still standing there blankly, not noticing at all that the powerful offensive was about to give him a fatal blow!
And just when... the secret attack unleashed by the old monster from the Underworld was about to hit the vital point in Reine's heart, causing him to completely die.
Beside Reine, a slightly blurry figure appeared in an instant.
He didn't even completely solidify his body, but he directly used a palm to restrain the terrifying offensive of the old monster from the Underworld!
This makes it impossible for this attack to sneak forward even half an inch.
At this time, the palm of the old monster from the underworld and Rene's vital point were only one finger apart!
Although what happened here is quite complicated to describe, in fact, it all happened in an instant!
And the danger level has finally reached the peak point that can wake up Rene from his stunned state!
Rene woke up from his dull expression.
His face suddenly filled with alarm and rage, and he stared at the old monster from Minglu who had a serious look in his eyes, all focused on the person next to him who was trying to stop his attack.
Seeing that the old monster from the Underworld didn't look at him at all, Rene turned his head slightly and looked towards where the old monster from the Underworld was looking.
I saw that the figure that had not yet solidified before was already solidified in an instant starting from its stretched out palms, unfolding from the outside to the inside, from point to point.
Although the figure's eyes were slightly solemn at the moment, it could not hide the mocking smile that overflowed from the corners of his mouth.
Judging from his appearance, it was the Holy Spirit Transformation Sect Ling Qingsheng who was about to kill Renie when he saw the old monster from the Underworld taking advantage of it to be in a stalemate - "Old Man Ling!"
"Old monster! Are you looking for death?!"
The words of the old monster from Minglu, filled with murderous intent, rang in the ears of Reine and Lingqing Saint.
"Haha, isn't it a bit against the rules for fellow Taoist Ming to behave like this?!"
"Previously, Fellow Daoist Lei received your all-out attack from the Sky-Breaking True Fire. According to the rules here, Fellow Daoist Lei has already succeeded in the challenge, and you can't do anything to him again!"
When Saint Lingqing heard this, he smiled sarcastically and said calmly.
"Hmph!"
The old monster from Minglu snorted coldly and stared at Lingqing Sheng and Renie with some evil eyes, scanning their faces.
Then he spoke and said in a low voice.
"This Rene actually has two magic weapons. I guess you borrowed them from him, right?!"
"Okay!"
"Looking at the huge price you spent, you monster, even if this person has accomplished the challenge! He will no longer have to participate in the next battle between the two countries!"
"However, Mr. Lei! In the blood training of your disciples, you must let your disciples take good care of each other. Don't end up with the whole army destroyed when the time comes!"
After uttering sarcastic words and threatening words to Ling Qing Sheng and Reine respectively, the old monster from Minglu immediately flicked his sleeves, and his figure suddenly blurred, disappearing in the blink of an eye of Reine and the others.
